name: ECDICT corpus subset
notes: Upstream repository declares MIT. Preserve LICENSE-ECDICT.txt when distributing dictionary subset. This verifies upstream licensing, not an independent audit of every historical contributing source.
lemma.en.txt was inspected but NOT used: its header separately limits free use to research/education and its mappings are unsuitable for unrestricted general distribution.
Dictionary text and phonetics are verbatim upstream values except CSV literal newline expansion.

No definitions were generated. Explicit ECDICT exchange fields identify baseforms; apostrophe-s lookups are labeled possessive_or_contraction and must be displayed as related-base lookups, not definitive contextual meanings.
